challenges.name: order-history-state-machine
challenges.title: Model the Order history screen as a state machine
challenges.description: The courier app's Order history screen showed the empty illustration while it was still loading, offered Retry while a list was on screen, and once replaced fresh orders with the answer to an older request that arrived late. It now has four states (`Loading`, `Content`, `Empty`, `Error`) and every request carries a number `gen`; answers carry the number of the request they answer. The editor holds `next(state, event)` with its blocks missing, each marked by a `// [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Fill every line so that: opening the screen starts loading; an answer with orders shows them, an answer with none shows the empty state; a failed first load shows the error screen, but a failed refresh keeps the list and shows a notice; Retry works only on the error screen; refresh keeps the list (reloads an empty screen) and is ignored while loading; and an answer to any request other than the latest changes nothing. Run feeds events and prints the state after each one.
hints: Draw the four states as boxes and each event as an arrow. Which arrows exist from each box, and which events must leave the state unchanged?
Look at the order of checks: an answer to an older request must be dropped before any branch looks at it, whatever state the screen is in. `state.gen` is the number of the latest request.

A media player as a state machine: `if (event is Event.Loaded && event.trackId != state.trackId) return state`, then `when (event) { is Event.Play -> if (state is Player.Paused) Player.Playing(state.trackId) else state; is Event.Error -> if (state is Player.Playing) state.copy(warning = event.reason) else Player.Failed(event.reason, state.trackId) ... }`.

tests.name: No orders yet: the empty state, never a spinner-shaped empty list
tests.expected:
start 1 -> Loading(gen=1)
success 1 -> Empty(gen=1)
refresh 2 -> Loading(gen=2)
success 2 O-1041 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=2)

tests.name: Offline first load: error screen, Retry loads again
tests.input:
start 1
failure 1 offline
retry 2
success 2 O-1041,O-1042
tests.expected:
start 1 -> Loading(gen=1)
failure 1 offline -> Error(message=offline, gen=1)
retry 2 -> Loading(gen=2)
success 2 O-1041,O-1042 -> Content(items=[O-1041, O-1042], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=2)

tests.name: The incident: a late answer to the first request does not replace the fresh list
tests.input:
start 1
success 1 O-1041
refresh 2
success 1 O-1041
success 2 O-1041,O-1042
tests.expected:
start 1 -> Loading(gen=1)
success 1 O-1041 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=1)
refresh 2 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=true, notice=null, gen=2)
success 1 O-1041 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=true, notice=null, gen=2)
success 2 O-1041,O-1042 -> Content(items=[O-1041, O-1042], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=2)

tests.name: A failed refresh keeps the list and shows a notice
tests.input:
start 1
success 1 O-1041,O-1042
refresh 2
failure 2 timeout
refresh 3
success 3 O-1043
tests.expected:
start 1 -> Loading(gen=1)
success 1 O-1041,O-1042 -> Content(items=[O-1041, O-1042], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=1)
refresh 2 -> Content(items=[O-1041, O-1042], refreshing=true, notice=null, gen=2)
failure 2 timeout -> Content(items=[O-1041, O-1042], refreshing=false, notice=timeout, gen=2)
refresh 3 -> Content(items=[O-1041, O-1042], refreshing=true, notice=null, gen=3)
success 3 O-1043 -> Content(items=[O-1043], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=3)

tests.name: Refresh while loading and Retry on content are ignored
tests.input:
start 1
refresh 2
success 1 O-1041
retry 3
failure 0 stale
tests.expected:
start 1 -> Loading(gen=1)
refresh 2 -> Loading(gen=1)
success 1 O-1041 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=1)
retry 3 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=1)
failure 0 stale -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=1)

tests.name: Reopening the screen drops answers to the earlier visit
tests.input:
start 1
success 1 O-1041
refresh 2
start 3
success 2 O-1041,O-1042
failure 3 timeout
tests.expected:
start 1 -> Loading(gen=1)
success 1 O-1041 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=false, notice=null, gen=1)
refresh 2 -> Content(items=[O-1041], refreshing=true, notice=null, gen=2)
start 3 -> Loading(gen=3)
success 2 O-1041,O-1042 -> Loading(gen=3)
failure 3 timeout -> Error(message=timeout, gen=3)
